headline: Quit asks, close keeps
highlights: ⌘Q asks before losing work: if a batch is still running — a transcription run, a package build — the quit pauses on one plain question instead of silently abandoning it. With nothing at risk it just quits; review decisions, edits, comments, and flags are already saved the moment they happen.

⌘W closes the window and only the window — the app keeps running with your project loaded, and a click on the Dock icon brings the same window back exactly as it was. Closing the window no longer quits the app; that is ⌘Q's job. ⌘⇧W still closes the project itself.
